calls.title: Tanaaz Khan and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The team discussed enhancing Growth Book's market position as a top feature flagging solution, distinct from competitors like LaunchDarkly. Ashley Stirrup’s framework highlighted strengths and emphasized a shift in marketing focus from experimentation to feature flags. The upcoming website relaunch on April 23 aims to improve messaging and SEO, introducing role-based pages. Content development will prioritize high-quality feature flagging resources, utilizing customer insights to boost authenticity. A video podcast strategy is in place, aiming to increase engagement and outreach through consolidated content hubs. Long-term SEO plans will focus on niche content and real-world examples to enhance authority and differentiation in the market.
calls.keywords: Feature Flags, Messaging, Website Launch, Content Strategy, Podcast, AI Development
